purpose: Isolate MPS client/context lifecycle from optional GPU overrun by retiring an initialized NeuralRx worker without submitting any work, then running mandatory RAN releases.

selection_source.confirm28: Worker-free conventional-only control had 0/10000 D35 misses.
selection_source.confirm30: Overrun drain plus immediate process retirement had 17/10000 post-retirement D35 misses, but overrun and teardown were coupled.

lifecycle_fault.worker: initialized persistent NeuralRx CUDA Graph RPC worker
lifecycle_fault.retirement: send stop and close the MPS client before the first timed RAN release

interpretation.fail: A miss falsifies the assumption that an initialized MPS client can be retired safely during a live RAN epoch even without an optional overrun.
interpretation.pass: No observed miss narrows confirm30 to overrun-plus-retirement or residual-state interaction; it does not prove teardown universally safe.
